club_status = '1'
ORDER BY clubowner_key DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content FROM Club WHERE clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND club_status = '1'

SELECT p.clubjoin_num, position, height, weight, join_date, p.status, m.userName, m.userLevel, m.memberIdx, c.club_logo, m2.profile_photo, pr.rating FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN Club c ON c.clubOwner_key = p.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Member2 m2 ON m.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Player_Record pr ON p.clubJoin_num = pr.clubJoin_num WHERE p.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND club_status = '1' ORDER BY p.clubjoin_num
SELECT userName FROM clubOwner cq JOIN Member1 m ON cq.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE cq.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key}

SELECT p.clubjoin_num, position, uniform_no, height, weight, p.clubowner_key, TO_CHAR(join_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') join_date, p.status, m.userName, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') birth, tel, gender, goal, assist, yellow, red FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN Club c ON c.clubOwner_key = p.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Member2 m2 ON m.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Player_Record pr ON p.clubJoin_num = pr.clubJoin_num WHERE p.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND club_status = '1'
